chunks: Have you thought, if he had been on guidance
ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'Have you thought' refer to in Surah Al-Alaq?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this rhetorical question targets Al-Walid ibn al-Mughirah, highlighting the irony of a man claiming exclusive divine favor while denying the resurrection. It underscores the concept of *Zalim* (self-oppressor) who, despite outward piety, is blinded by arrogance and materialism, a theme central to the Surah's critique of Meccan elite.
